title: Set up Snowflake MCP OAuth
subtitle: Use Manual OAuth, add the redirect URI, set roles, and test both connection types.

steps.title: Use Manual OAuth
steps.evidence: Copilot Studio must use Manual OAuth because Snowflake lacks Dynamic Client Registration.

steps.title: Add connector redirect URI
steps.evidence: Copy it from the connector Security tab and add it to the Entra client app.

steps.title: Configure secondary roles
steps.evidence: Add the generated custom connector redirect URI to Entra, configure DEFAULT_SECONDARY_ROLES, and test both maker and end-user connections.

steps.title: Test both connection types
steps.evidence: Both connections must succeed for end-to-end tool calls.
